ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As seen in the diagram, three darts are thrown at nine fixed balloons. If a balloon is hit it will burst and the dart continues in the same direction it had beforehand. How many balloons will not be hit by a dart?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are a total of nine fixed balloons, with three darts on the left side, and the arrows all point horizontally to the right, representing three horizontal flight paths. The upper path passes through an upper gray balloon and a larger dark-colored balloon in the upper right; the middle path passes through the small white balloon in the middle and the black balloon on the far right; the lower path passes through the large white balloon in the lower left and the small dark-colored balloon in the middle of the bottom. Reasoning: After a dart hits a balloon, it still moves horizontally in the original direction, so all intersecting balloons on each horizontal path will be hit. The three paths hit a total of 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 balloons. There are 9 balloons in total, so the number of balloons not hit is 9 - 6 = 3.

method.method_draft: Trace the three dart trajectories horizontally from left to right as shown by the arrows. From the image, the top dart line intersects the upper gray balloon and the tall dark balloon near the upper right; the middle dart line intersects the small white balloon near the center and the far-right black balloon; the bottom dart line intersects the large white balloon near the lower left and the small dark balloon near the bottom center. Thus 6 of the 9 balloons are hit, so compute 9 - 6 = 3 balloons not hit.
